(ITEM_CODE like concat('%',concat(#{finprodId},'%')) or ITEM_VALUE like concat('%',concat(#{finprodId},'%')))
UNION SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, FINPROD_MARKET_ID name, FINPROD_ABBR shortName, FINPROD_MARKET_ID hidCode FROM FIN_PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.FINPROD_ID
(FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{finprodId},'%')) or FINPROD_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{finprodId},'%')))
AND FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_8 IS NOT NULL AND TRADE_MARKET IN（'03','04') AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN('F01','F06','F10')
